title: Two plans of Tŷ Mawr

shots.direction: Slow push-in across the reading-room table as Nia lays two thin folders side by side and pulls on cotton gloves; the Grandson leans in.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal modern county records office reading room, soft daylight from tall windows, long oak table with grey archive folders and pencils. Welsh woman in her 30s with a black bob, round tortoiseshell glasses and a mustard cardigan pulling on white cotton gloves. Beside her a man in his 40s with dark curly hair, blue eyes, short beard and waxed jacket, laptop open. Calm, warm, documentary feel, no text, no heraldry.

lines.en: Bore da. Two plans of Tŷ Mawr, about ten years apart, from two different family collections.
lines.cy: Bore da. Dau gynllun o Tŷ Mawr, ryw ddeng mlynedd ar wahân, o ddwy gasgliad teuluol wahanol.
lines.es: Bore da. Dos planos de Tŷ Mawr, con unos diez años de diferencia, de dos colecciones familiares distintas.

lines.en: These are printouts.
lines.cy: Printiadau ydy'r rhain.
lines.es: Estas son impresiones.

lines.en: Catalogue entries. We haven't seen either original plan yet. The request slips go in today.
lines.cy: Cofnodion catalog. Dŷn ni heb weld yr un o'r cynlluniau gwreiddiol eto. Mae'r slipiau cais yn mynd i mewn heddiw.
lines.es: Fichas de catálogo. Aún no vimos ninguno de los planos originales. Los pedidos salen hoy.

shots.direction: Overhead insert of the first catalogue printout under Nia's gloved finger.
shots.image_prompt: Overhead close-up of a single printed archive catalogue page on an oak table, a white-gloved fingertip resting beside it, pencil nearby, shallow depth of field, lettering too soft to read, no heraldry.

lines.en: Glamorgan Archives, DMAT/279: 'Late 18th-century plan of Ty Mawr farm, Llandough, then Gedrych property.'
lines.cy: Archifau Morgannwg, DMAT/279: 'Cynllun o ddiwedd y 18fed ganrif o fferm Tŷ Mawr, Llandochau, eiddo Gedrych bryd hynny.'
lines.es: Glamorgan Archives, DMAT/279: 'Plano de finales del siglo XVIII de la granja Ty Mawr, Llandough, entonces propiedad de Gedrych.'

lines.en: Gedrych. Not a name I've met in any of the family papers.
lines.cy: Gedrych. Dim enw dwi wedi dod ar ei draws mewn unrhyw bapurau teuluol.
lines.es: Gedrych. Un nombre que no encontré en ningún papel familiar.

shots.direction: Talking close-up of Nia, glasses pushed up, explaining while she taps the printout.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up of a Welsh woman in her 30s, black bob, round tortoiseshell glasses, mustard cardigan, white cotton gloves, speaking thoughtfully across a records-office table, soft window light, no text.

lines.en: Nor me. It sits among the estate plans of the Mathew family of Radyr and Llandaff, dated about 1790. It shows the farm was worth drawing, and was filed with that family's estates. From the entry alone it doesn't show who farmed it.
lines.cy: Na finnau chwaith. Mae'n eistedd ymysg cynlluniau stad teulu Mathew o Radur a Llandaf, wedi'i ddyddio tua 1790. Mae'n dangos bod y fferm werth ei darlunio, ac fe'i cadwyd gydag ystadau'r teulu hwnnw. O'r cofnod yn unig, dyw e ddim yn dangos pwy oedd yn ffermio yno.
lines.es: Ni yo. Está entre los planos de la propiedad de la familia Mathew de Radyr y Llandaff, de alrededor de 1790. Muestra que la granja merecía dibujarse, y fue archivada con esas propiedades. Solo con la ficha no se sabe quién la trabajaba.

shots.direction: Talking close-up of the Grandson, frowning at his laptop notes.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up of a man in his 40s with dark curly hair, blue eyes, short beard, waxed jacket, laptop glow on his face in a records-office reading room, no text.

lines.en: So no Williams on it.
lines.cy: Felly does dim Williams arno.
lines.es: Entonces ningún Williams aparece ahí.

lines.en: No tenants named in the entry at all. When the original comes up, we look for fields, buildings and any writing in the margins.
lines.cy: Dim tenantiaid wedi'u henwi yn y cofnod o gwbl. Pan ddaw'r gwreiddiol i'r golwg, edrychwn ni am gaeau, adeiladau ac unrhyw ysgrifen ar yr ymylon.
lines.es: La ficha no nombra arrendatarios en absoluto. Cuando llegue el original, buscamos campos, edificios y anotaciones en los márgenes.

shots.direction: Insert of the second catalogue printout as the Grandson slides it into the light.
shots.image_prompt: Overhead close-up of a second printed archive catalogue page on an oak table next to a laptop, a man's hand sliding it into a pool of daylight, lettering too soft to read, no heraldry.

lines.en: DXJF/61/12. 'Plan of Ty Mawr farm, Llandough', circa 1800. Corbett Family of Cogan Pill Papers.
lines.cy: DXJF/61/12. 'Cynllun o fferm Tŷ Mawr, Llandochau', tua 1800. Papurau Teulu Corbett o Cogan Pill.
lines.es: DXJF/61/12. 'Plano de la granja Ty Mawr, Llandough', circa 1800. Papeles de la familia Corbett de Cogan Pill.

shots.direction: Two-shot across the table, the two printouts between them, slight handheld drift.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal two-shot in a records-office reading room: Welsh woman in her 30s with black bob, tortoiseshell glasses, mustard cardigan and cotton gloves facing a bearded man in his 40s in a waxed jacket, two printed sheets between them on the oak table, no text.

lines.en: A different family's papers. Did the farm change hands between the two?
lines.cy: Papurau teulu gwahanol. Wnaeth y fferm newid dwylo rhwng y ddau?
lines.es: Papeles de otra familia distinta. ¿La granja cambió de dueño entre un plano y otro?

lines.en: Maybe. Or one family kept a copy of another's plan; estates passed surveys around. Two catalogue lines can't tell us which. And 'circa' means the date was judged from the drawing, not written on it.
lines.cy: Efallai. Neu fe gadwodd un teulu gopi o gynllun teulu arall; roedd stadau'n rhannu arolygon rhyngddyn nhw. Dyw dwy linell gatalog ddim yn gallu dweud wrthon ni pa un. Ac mae 'tua' yn golygu bod y dyddiad wedi'i farnu o'r darlun, nid wedi'i ysgrifennu arno.
lines.es: Puede ser. O una familia guardó copia del plano de otra; las propiedades se pasaban los relevamientos. Dos líneas de catálogo no nos dicen cuál. Y 'circa' significa que la fecha se calculó por el dibujo, no está escrita.

shots.direction: Talking close-up of the Grandson as he types a heading.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up of a bearded man in his 40s, dark curly hair, waxed jacket, typing on a laptop, half-smile, records-office background softly blurred, no text.

lines.en: Then it goes in as two plans, two collections, one open question.
lines.cy: Felly fe aiff i mewn fel dau gynllun, dwy gasgliad, un cwestiwn agored.
lines.es: Entonces va como dos planos, dos colecciones, una pregunta abierta.

lines.en: Ingredients, not a verdict.
lines.cy: Cynhwysion, nid dyfarniad.
lines.es: Son datos, no una conclusión.

shots.direction: Tracking shot following the pair up a quiet modern Llandough street on a bright autumn morning.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal modern Llandough village street on a hill near Cardiff, autumn morning, stone walls and terraced houses, a Welsh woman with a black bob and mustard cardigan under a coat walking with a bearded man in a waxed jacket carrying folders, no signage text, no heraldry.

lines.en: While surveyors paced those fields, the village was building. It's up the hill.
lines.cy: Tra oedd y syrfewyr yn cerdded y caeau hynny, roedd y pentref yn adeiladu. Mae i fyny'r bryn.
lines.es: Mientras los agrimensores recorrían esos campos, el pueblo crecía. Está cuesta arriba.

shots.direction: Slow tilt up the front of a small 19th-century stone school building at a road corner, the pair stopping at the pavement.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal exterior of a small early-19th-century stone former church school building with pointed-arch windows on a road corner in Llandough, Vale of Glamorgan, two people seen from behind on the pavement, overcast autumn light, no text, no plaques, no heraldry.

lines.en: Penlan Road, corner of Lewis Road. This is it?
lines.cy: Heol Penlan, cornel Heol Lewis. Dyma fe?
lines.es: Penlan Road, esquina con Lewis Road. ¿Es esto?

lines.en: The former National School, built 1821. Coflein, the national monuments record, has it as site 31824, grid reference ST 16740 73140.
lines.cy: Yr hen Ysgol Genedlaethol, wedi'i hadeiladu ym 1821. Mae Coflein, y gofnod henebion cenedlaethol, yn ei nodi fel safle 31824, cyfeirnod grid ST 16740 73140.
lines.es: La antigua Escuela Nacional, construida en 1821. Coflein, el registro nacional de monumentos, la tiene como sitio 31824, referencia de cuadrícula ST 16740 73140.

shots.direction: Insert of the monuments-record printout clipped into the Grandson's folder.
shots.image_prompt: Close-up of a printed heritage record page with a small grey site map clipped into an open card folder, held in a man's hand outdoors, lettering too soft to read, no heraldry.

shots.direction: Talking close-up of Nia outside the old school, wind in her hair.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal close-up of a Welsh woman in her 30s with black bob and tortoiseshell glasses, coat over mustard cardigan, speaking outdoors in front of an old stone school wall, autumn light, no text.

lines.en: Did Tŷ Mawr children learn their letters here?
lines.cy: Oedd plant Tŷ Mawr yn dysgu eu llythrennau yma?
lines.es: ¿Los chicos de Tŷ Mawr aprendieron sus letras aquí?

lines.en: The record dates the building and puts it on the map. It doesn't list pupils. If registers survive, they're somewhere else.
lines.cy: Mae'r cofnod yn dyddio'r adeilad ac yn ei osod ar y map. Dyw e ddim yn rhestru disgyblion. Os yw cofrestri wedi goroesi, maen nhw yn rhywle arall.
lines.es: El registro fecha el edificio y lo ubica en el mapa. No lista alumnos. Si quedan registros, están en otro lado.

shots.direction: Wide closing shot from down the hill, the pair turning back toward the view over the Ely.
shots.image_prompt: Photoreal wide shot of Llandough hill street with a small old stone school building, two small figures turning downhill, view toward the Ely valley and Cardiff Bay in hazy distance, autumn, no text, no heraldry.

lines.en: Thirty-one years: two drawings of the farm, and a schoolroom on the hill.
lines.cy: Un deg tri mlynedd ar hugain: dau ddarlun o'r fferm, ac ystafell ysgol ar y bryn.
lines.es: Treinta y un años: dos dibujos de la granja, y un aula en la colina.

lines.en: Next, an 1824 surveyor who wrote the farm's name two ways. Bring a pencil.
lines.cy: Nesaf, syrfëwr o 1824 a ysgrifennodd enw'r fferm mewn dwy ffordd. Dewch â phensil.
lines.es: Ahora, un agrimensor de 1824 que escribió el nombre de la granja de dos formas. Traigan un lápiz.

continuity: The Man from the Estate presents David Stewart's 1824 survey of 'Cedfin or Ty Mawr Farm'; request slips for DMAT/279 and DXJF/61/12 are still pending.
